WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb)
  AS x(document_id text, schema_version text, context_id text, status text, intake_channel text, intake_adapter_id text, source_external_id text, original_filename text,
       received_at timestamptz, source_event_id text, mime_type text, size_bytes bigint, page_count integer, content_hash text, text_fingerprint text,
       document_type_key text, category_key text, case_id text, case_number text, case_match_method text, review_required boolean, review_blocked_stage text,
       last_completed_stage text, duplicate_of text, extraction_result_ref text, analysis_ref text, analysis_version text, body jsonb)
), fremd AS (
  SELECT d.document_id FROM jarvis_privat.document d JOIN r ON d.content_hash = r.content_hash AND d.document_id <> r.document_id
), vorher AS (
  SELECT d.document_id, (d.body = r.body) AS gleich FROM jarvis_privat.document d JOIN r ON d.document_id = r.document_id
), up AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.document (document_id, schema_version, context_id, status, intake_channel, intake_adapter_id, source_external_id, original_filename, received_at, source_event_id,
       mime_type, size_bytes, page_count, content_hash, text_fingerprint, document_type_key, category_key, case_id, case_number, case_match_method, review_required,
       review_blocked_stage, last_completed_stage, duplicate_of, extraction_result_ref, analysis_ref, analysis_version, body)
  SELECT document_id, schema_version, context_id, status, intake_channel, intake_adapter_id, source_external_id, original_filename, received_at, source_event_id,
       mime_type, size_bytes, page_count, content_hash, text_fingerprint, document_type_key, category_key, case_id, case_number, case_match_method, coalesce(review_required, false),
       review_blocked_stage, last_completed_stage, duplicate_of, extraction_result_ref, analysis_ref, analysis_version, body
  FROM r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fremd)
  ON CONFLICT (document_id) DO UPDATE SET
    status = EXCLUDED.status, page_count = EXCLUDED.page_count, text_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.text_fingerprint,
    document_type_key = EXCLUDED.document_type_key, category_key = EXCLUDED.category_key, case_id = EXCLUDED.case_id,
    case_number = EXCLUDED.case_number, case_match_method = EXCLUDED.case_match_method, review_required = EXCLUDED.review_required,
    review_blocked_stage = EXCLUDED.review_blocked_stage, last_completed_stage = EXCLUDED.last_completed_stage, duplicate_of = EXCLUDED.duplicate_of,
    extraction_result_ref = EXCLUDED.extraction_result_ref, analysis_ref = EXCLUDED.analysis_ref, analysis_version = EXCLUDED.analysis_version,
    body = EXCLUDED.body, updated_at = now()
  WHERE jarvis_privat.document.body IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.body
  RETURNING document_id
)
SELECT coalesce((SELECT document_id FROM fremd LIMIT 1), (SELECT document_id FROM up), (SELECT document_id FROM vorher)) AS resolved_id,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fremd) THEN 'duplicate_content'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vorher WHERE gleich) THEN 'unchanged'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vorher) THEN 'updated'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM up) THEN 'created'
            ELSE 'conflict' END AS write_outcome

SELECT (d.document_id IS NOT NULL) AS found, $2::text AS write_outcome, d.document_id, d.context_id, d.status, d.intake_channel, d.intake_adapter_id, d.source_external_id,
       d.original_filename, to_char(d.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS received_at, d.source_event_id, d.mime_type,
       d.size_bytes::integer AS size_bytes, d.page_count, d.content_hash, d.document_type_key, d.category_key, d.case_id, d.case_number, d.case_match_method,
       d.review_required, d.last_completed_stage, d.duplicate_of
FROM (SELECT 1) AS eins LEFT JOIN jarvis_privat.document d ON d.document_id = $1

const e = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { status: 'dry_run', adapter_id: e.adapter_id, tool_id: e.tool_id, context_id: e.context_id, action_id: e.action_id, write_outcome: 'none', expected: e.expected, trace_id: e.trace_id } }];

const e = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { status: 'error', adapter_id: e.adapter_id, tool_id: e.tool_id, context_id: e.context_id, action_id: e.action_id, write_outcome: 'none', error: { error_class: 'validation', error_code: 'invalid_input', retryable: false, message: e.fehler.join('; ') }, trace_id: e.trace_id } }];
